facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's 2019 statistical yearbook states that health facilities send standard paper reports to the health zone before the 5th of each month and the zone keys them before the 20th, entry being done in every health zone and, since September 2014, on the single DHIS2 platform for aggregated facility statistics.
facts.system: Système National d'Information et de Gestion Sanitaires (SNIGS) / DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's 2019 statistical yearbook states that at certain community relays and health facilities the completed monthly forms are keyed directly into the data warehouse by the 20th of each month, and gives no number or share of such facilities.
facts.system: Système National d'Information et de Gestion Sanitaires (SNIGS) / DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's 2019 statistical yearbook states that the SNIGS collects data monthly, quarterly and annually from the country's health facilities on standard paper forms, naming a monthly return for health centres (B5a) and one for hospitals (B5b) and reporting indicators for the national teaching hospital (CNHU); it names no tier below the health centre.
facts.system: Système National d'Information et de Gestion Sanitaires (SNIGS) / DHIS2

facts.fact: The 2019 statistical yearbook is issued by the Ministry of Health's SNIGS unit (SNIGS-MS), and the Minister of Health's foreword states that technical and financial partners accompany the ministry in collecting, processing, producing and disseminating health information.
facts.system: Système National d'Information et de Gestion Sanitaires (SNIGS) / DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's 2019 statistical yearbook states that a rapid evaluation of the SNIGS held in November 2018 led to an Operational Plan for Strengthening the SNIGS 2019-2020.
facts.system: Système National d'Information et de Gestion Sanitaires (SNIGS) / DHIS2

note: The file is an excerpt: front matter, foreword, introduction and methodology only; the annexes with report completeness by department (2018) and the list of facilities that took part in the SNIGS in 2019 were not captured, so no completeness or facility count could be read. The yearbook also lists, without describing them, sub-systems for programme information, administrative and financial management, periodic surveys and civil registration, and says most other sub-systems are integrated into the DHIS2 platform; and that private facilities not reporting to the SNIGS are estimated from a national census of private facilities. T1 to T3 in the tiers fact is read from the form names (hospital, health centre) and the CNHU indicators.
